description.value:
Namekians have the ability to permenantly split themselves into 2 diametricly opposed people. At an action on your turn, you may split into 2. Class Levels, HP, KI, and Stamina are split as evenly as possible amoung the now 2 unique entities.

If these two entities were to fuse through Namekian Fusion then both characters are fully added together when one is assimilated.
